issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'không cần sự cần dùng gì ngoài việc' (doesn't need anything except) misrepresents the Greek 'ου χρειαν εχει η τους ποδας νιψασθαι' (has no need to wash his feet). The Greek is a simple negation of the necessity of washing feet, whereas the Vietnamese adds a restrictive 'except' structure that alters the logic of the statement.
